detailed_descriptions.en: Figuré Shop Simulator is a fun and detailed business simulation game where you manage your own figure shop. Produce figures with 3D printers, stock your shelves, set prices, and offer the best shopping experience to your customers. To grow your business, efficiently manage your storage, expand your store, and customize its design. Create rare figures for collectors, follow trends, and increase your profits by stocking the most in-demand figures. But be careful! Stock management, customer satisfaction, and pricing are crucial to your business's success. Can you make the right strategic decisions to take your shop to the top of the industry? detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Figuré Shop Simulator is a fun and detailed business simulation game where you manage your own figure shop. Produce figures with 3D printers, stock your shelves, set prices, and offer the best shopping experience to your customers.

To grow your business, efficiently manage your storage, expand your store, and customize its design. Create rare figures for collectors, follow trends, and increase your profits by stocking the most in-demand figures.

But be careful! Stock management, customer satisfaction, and pricing are crucial to your business's success. Can you make the right strategic decisions to take your shop to the top of the industry?

Key Features:

  • 3D figure production and customization

  • Shelf management, pricing, and customer satisfaction

  • Expand your store and personalize its design

  • Create collection sets and discover rare figures

  • Follow market trends and identify best-selling products

Build your shop from the ground up and become the biggest name in the figure collecting world!
